ideas.title: Investigation into Alex Pretti's Killing
ideas.description: Investigate the circumstances surrounding Alex Pretti's killing by federal agents in Minneapolis
ideas.angle: Potential civil rights violations and use of force by federal agents
questions: Were federal agents justified in using force?

ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential patterns of abuse of power by federal agents in Minnesota
